This is a Python project for reverse image search using computer vision techniques. The project uses:

- OpenCV for image processing
- NumPy for numerical operations
- scikit-image for feature extraction
- PIL (Python Imaging Library) for image handling

Please provide suggestions and code that follow best practices for image processing and efficient search algorithms.
